data.data_quality_notes: There is a significant discrepancy in prior year development figures. The 'Claims incurred during the year related to: Prior underwriting years' line in Note 12 (Technical Provisions) shows a gross release of $0.003 million. However, the same line shows a net strengthening of $1.044 million. Furthermore, the 'Claims Movement' narrative in Note 4 states a net favourable development of $0.3 million for past accident years, which contradicts the net figure in Note 12. The gross claims development triangle (Note 17) indicates a gross release of $1.342 million for underwriting years 2011-2013. The gross figure from Note 12 has been used for prior_year_development_gbp_m as it is the most direct statement of the gross movement during the year.
